mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within the last month indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, driving the S&P 500 forward returns negatively over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over the last quarter indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the quarters with positive GDP growth, or if the correlation between GDP growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within the last two months signals increased economic activity and potential inflationary pressures, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures indicates a strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both proxies increase, or if the joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over the last month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate, signals a strong labor market and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of PAYEMS and UNRATE on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index over the last two months indicates rising inflation, which can lead to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures by more than 1% within the last month signals weakening consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between RSAFS decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
